title: Amazing! Pumps out tons of humidity!
text: Amazing! Pumps out tons of humidity!. Bought this for my parents and they love it. I had bought them a very expensive Air-O-Swiss but it was a nightmare to clean. This is much easier as the whole top comes off and the bottom is fully accessible. If you use it 24/7 (which I recommend in dry climates) clean it out with vinegar once a week. Id you wait a month you will be pulling out the bleach to clean this and you don’t want that. Just clean it once a week, let vinegar sit in the base and rinse our the main water container with soap or vinegar and you’re good to go! Highly recommend!

product_metadata.title: Humidific Cool Mist Humidifier Vaporizer for Bedroom: Ultrasonic Air Humidifiers 5L for Large Room - Top Fill Easy Clean Vaporizers for Plants
features: 【5L Large Capacity Humidifier】This air humidifier has a 5L big capacity water tank and can work for up to 42 hours. It has 2 nozzles that can rotate 360° on the top, which can disperse the mist in any direction. You can easily adjust the direction of the fog. The water humidifier can humidify the air and create a comfortable environment for you.

【Ultrasonic Cool Mist Humidifiers】This cold vaporizer uses advanced ultrasonic technology, it will not produce noise when working, even if it is used at night, there is no need to worry that it will disturb your sleep. It is widely used in bedroom, office and spa.

【Top Filling & Easy Clean】This humidifier vaporizer uses a top filling design, and the cover on the top of the water tank can be easily removed, which is convenient for you to add water or clean. And it is easy to clean. The filterless humidifier is made of BPA-free materials, non-toxic and harmless, safe and reliable.

【Water Vaporizer】The large room humidifier has 7 soft colors of light, which can be used as a night light. It has 2 light modes: automatic cycle change and fixed one color. You can turn on/off the night light through the light button and adjust the light mode you like.

【Timer & Fog Mode】This air vaporizer has a timer function, with 4 timers (12H/6H/2H). When the time is up or the water runs out, the humidifier will automatically shut down. The cold fog humidifier has 4 fog modes, and the strength of the mist can be adjusted through the "MIST+" and "MIST-" buttons on the top.
description: This product can be used as a cold water humidifier as well as a colorful night light. It has two working modes: fog and light. These two modes can work individually or together. Features: 1.5L large capacity water tank, working time up to 42 hours. 2.7 soothing light colors and 2 adjustable light modes (automatically change/fix one color). 3.3 timers: 12H/6H/2H. 4.4 kinds of fog modes, can adjust strong fog and weak fog. 5. The top filling design is convenient to add water and easy to clean. 6. Does not contain BPA, non-toxic and harmless. 7. Using ultrasonic technology, the working sound is small. 8. When the water runs out or the time is up, the humidifier will automatically shut down. 9.2 360°rotating nozzles, the direction of mist can be adjusted freely. Usage steps: 1. Remove the lid; 2. Insert the power cord; 3. Add an appropriate amount of water (be careful not to exceed the capacity of 5L); 4. Close the lid and press the ON/OFF button. Button description: 1. Press the "MIST+" button to increase the fog, and press the "MIST-" button to weaken the fog. 2. Press the "ON/OFF" button to turn the humidifier on or off. 3. Press the "TIME" button to set the time, you can see if the time indicator lights up. 4. Press the "LIGHT" button to turn on/off the light, and adjust the light to change the mode.
